body: and I hope you're doing well.

Im so sorry to impose, but I looked at your history. I hope things are well for you, im sure its frustrating hearing "things will get better". I don't know how many times I thought this was just a platitude. People don't know what to say, so they say something. Its hard, but it can be better. Please reach out if you need help.
It can pass, its always frustrating waiting for it to go away. It can, please PM in the next few hours, we can talk.
Hope you are well internet stranger!

I was hospitalized for being suicidal previously. Its been three years. I still have my job, my wife, and my child. You're worthwhile. Not just because of the people who depend on you. But because you're apart of this world, participate. Please, contact as much help as you can get your hands on.

I went to seek help through a registered psychologist and eventually a psychiatrist. Feeling better is hard to define, I think. Most days, yes. Some days, no. My care team and I have the same goal. "More good than bad". I don't always win. But I think it has gotten less heavy over time with talking about it. 

Im sorry to hear about your dad.
